order-confirmation.title: Order confirmation
order-confirmation.when: The moment an order is placed. The account part only when checkout opened an account for the address.

shop-new-order.title: New order
shop-new-order.when: The moment an order is placed, while mail_orders is on.

shop-new-question.title: New question
shop-new-question.when: When a chat question starts waiting for an answer, while mail_questions is on.

sample.text:
Does it come with a bulb?
And is the cable long enough to reach the floor from a bedside table?

chat-reply.title: Reply to a question
chat-reply.when: Five minutes after the shop replies, if the customer has not seen the reply by then.

sample.name: Ada Lovelace
sample.reply:
Yes, a warm white bulb is in the box.
The cable is 1.8 m, which reaches the floor from any bedside table.

verify-email.title: Verify email
verify-email.when: On registering, and whenever a customer asks for a new link from their account.

reset-password.title: Reset password
reset-password.when: When somebody asks for it on /forgot-password.

confirm-email-change.title: Confirm new email
confirm-email-change.when: When a customer changes their email address on /account.

login-alert.title: Login from a new location
login-alert.when: When an account signs in from a device or place it has not used before.
